subject: Request: scoped access snapshot & SAML assertion extracts for BeaconGrid audit intake
thread_summary: BeaconGrid's audit team requests a scoped SCIM snapshot and SAML assertion extracts to validate RBAC least-privilege mappings for SOC 2 intake. Internal coordination on extraction method, redaction, and delivery format. Final delivery attached and confirmation of receipt.
messages:
From: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@beacongrid.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: security+sig@beacongrid.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Audit intake — requested access exports for scoped roles

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. BeaconGrid's SOC 2 auditor needs a scoped view of user provisioning and assertion evidence for the period Oct–Dec 2025. Specifically we need: 

- SCIM delta including deprovision events for users with access to PHI-scoped resources (role tags: "PHI_read","PHI_write")
- SAML assertion samples for successful logins from the three most active service accounts in that period
- Current RBAC role matrix showing which groups map to which app permissions

Deliverables can be CSVs; we will be redacting identifiers on our side but would prefer that you remove full email addresses for internal-only service accounts and replace with stable hashed ids. Can you confirm:

1) Whether you can export the SCIM delta with a flag for provisioning action (create/update/patch/delete) and manager attribution
2) If SAML assertion logs can include saml:NameID, Audience, and the timestamp without raw IPs (we'll ask separately if IPs are needed)

Target: receipt by 2026-01-18 for timing with our auditor scan.

Best,
Caroline
Caroline Liu
Senior IT Security Analyst — BeaconGrid

[Attachment: audit_request_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@beacongrid.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit intake — requested access exports for scoped roles

Caroline —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll take the scoped export approach so you get only PHI-role-related events. Quick answers inline: 

1) SCIM delta: Yes — we can export create/update/patch/delete with the manager attribute and the group membership delta. We can replace internal emails with hashed ids as requested.
2) SAML assertions: We can pull assertion samples and emit NameID, Audience, AssertionID, and timestamp. We typically capture IPs but will exclude them unless you explicitly request them.

Plan: Naomi will run the SCIM delta extraction and generate a role-tag filter. Priyom will pull SAML assertion samples and assemble an RBAC matrix snapshot.

We will aim to deliver CSVs and an Excel role matrix by EOD 2026-01-18 PST. If you need an earlier partial delivery we can send the SCIM delta first.

One question: for hashed ids, do you prefer SHA256 hex or a short opaque token we agree on?

I'll start the extraction run and post links.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit intake — requested access exports for scoped roles

Dylan —

I ran a dry query against our provisioning logs and SCIM change feed. Notes: 

- There are ~1,200 delta rows between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31 that match the PHI role tags; most are nested group membership patches (ok)
- Manager attribution exists for 92% of the rows; the remaining entries have a null value from legacy Azure sync — we can annotate those as "manager_unknown"
- Hashing: I recommend SHA256 truncated to first 16 hex chars (so deterministic but non-reversible) as BeaconGrid asked for pseudonymized ids

I'll prepare beacongrid_scoped_access_snapshot_20260112.csv with columns: user_hash, action, timestamp, prev_groups, new_groups, manager_hash

I'll also prepare a small README describing the transformation and fields.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit intake — requested access exports for scoped roles

Team —

SAML assertion pull completed for the three service accounts Caroline called out (svc-search, svc-ingest, svc-embed). I exported samples where assertions indicated app access to the PHI-scoped audience. Output fields: AssertionID, NameID_hash, Audience, IssueInstant, AuthnContextClassRef. No IPs included.

Attached: saml_assertions_export_20260112.csv (10 sample assertions per service account).

RBAC matrix: I generated rbac_role_matrix_v1.xlsx — sheets: roles, groups_to_roles, service_accounts. I mapped group membership to app permissions and flagged any role granting write access to PHI-scoped endpoints. There are two roles that currently allow write; I marked them for review.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Applied ML — Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: saml_assertions_export_20260112.csv (csv), rbac_role_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@beacongrid.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Deliverable: scoped SCIM snapshot and SAML samples for BeaconGrid

Caroline —

Attached are the exports requested for your auditor:

- beacongrid_scoped_access_snapshot_20260112.csv (SCIM delta for PHI role tags; user ids hashed SHA256/16 hex)
- saml_assertions_export_20260112.csv (SAML assertion samples; IPs redacted; NameID hashed)
- rbac_role_matrix_v1.xlsx (current role mapping with flags for PHI write)

Delivery notes:
- Manager attribution: nulls labeled "manager_unknown" where our legacy sync had no value.
- Two roles flagged as granting PHI write; Naomi and Priyom have included suggested mitigations in the RBAC sheet comments.
- Files are in CSV/XLSX; if your auditor needs JSON or a different delimiter, we can provide that.

Please confirm receipt and if you'd like us to redact further (e.g., replace manager_hash with role-owner email masked).

Best,
Dylan

[Attachment: beacongrid_scoped_access_snapshot_20260112.csv (csv), saml_assertions_export_20260112.csv (csv), rbac_role_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@beacongrid.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: security+sig@beacongrid.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deliverable: scoped SCIM snapshot and SAML samples for BeaconGrid

Dylan / team —

Received everything, thank you. Auditor confirmed receipt and says the CSVs look good — they requested two small follow-ups: 

1) Could you include a brief README (1 page) that documents your hashing method and the time range used for the SCIM delta?
2) For the two roles flagged as PHI write, they want a short note confirming whether those roles are assigned to any external (partner) accounts.

If you can drop those two items by EOD Monday (2026-01-19) that would keep the audit on schedule. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Caroline
BeaconGrid IT Security

[Attachment: none]
